title: Watch: How President Lula turned it around to beat Flávio Bolsonaro
description: Brazil's left-wing President has been elected for a fourth term after narrowly beating right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro in a knife-edge vote.
text: Brazil's left-wing President has been elected for a fourth term after narrowly beating right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro in a knife-edge vote.
BBC's correspondent Ione Wells is in Brasília to explain the election results.
